source: create a boat racing game, roblox McDonald are present in every boat with the text saying"inspired by McDonald. Boat are in line to start the race

image_prompt.text: Buoy lines marking each boat lane along the water course
A start line across the water with the boats held in it side by side
A finish gate over the water at the far end of the course
A wide standardized launch front of evenly spaced slots so all the boats sit in line before the start
an open water racecourse rather than a land track
McDonalds branding and the words inspired by McDonald on the side of every boat

layout_placement.text: The held position each boat begins the race from
The round-ending detection zone at the end of the course
Evenly spaced boat slots across the starting line

notes: Sprint / Drag preset taken whole because the only layout detail given is the starting lineup; spawn-grid added on top for the boats in line, which the preset lacks.
No lap was mentioned, so the course is point to point rather than a circuit - worth confirming.
Racing has no way to state that the route surface is water.
